name: warden-desktop
description: warden — the one-click desktop app. Bundles Node, boots the agent worker + dashboard, opens it in a native window. No terminal, no npm.
author: warden

scripts.dist: npm run stage && electron-builder && npm run unstage
scripts.dist:win: npm run stage && electron-builder --win && npm run unstage
scripts.dist:mac: npm run stage && electron-builder --mac && npm run unstage
scripts.dist:linux: npm run stage && electron-builder --linux && npm run unstage
